summary: The root وَضَعَ (w-ḍ-ʿ) primarily means to put or lay down, the opposite of lifting up. It can also mean to give birth, impose or remit a tax, or cease hostilities.
lane: 1 وَضَعَهُ ذ He put it, or laid it, (KL, * PS,) in, or on, a place: (PS:) he put it, or threw it, down from his hand: (TA:) contr. of رَفَعَه : (Mgh:) syn. حَطَّهُ : (K, * TA, in art. حط :) but it has a more general sense than this last. (Er-Rághib, Kull.) -b2- وَضَعَ He put down a thing: contr. of رَفَعَ . (K, voce نَصَبَ .) -b3- وَضَعَتْ She brought forth. -b4- وَضَعَ لَهُ He appointed to him, or for him, a sign, or token, &c.: see Msb in art. علم . -b5- وَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ He imposed upon him a fine, or tax, &c. -b6- وَضَعَ He remitted a tax or the like; did not exact it. (Mgh, Msb, in art. جوح .) -b7- وَضَعُوا الحَرْبَ (assumed tropical:) [ They gave over, or relinquished, war; ] they made peace; opposed to رَفَعُوهَا . (Ham, pp. 179 and 180.) -b8- وَضَعَ مِنْهُ , (S,) or عَنْهُ , (K,) He lowered his grade, rank, condition, (S, K,) or estimation. (K.) -b9- وُضِعَ فِى تِجَارَتِهِ He lost, or suffered loss or diminution, in his traffic; (S, Mgh, Msb, K;) did not gain in it; (Mgh;) as also . (Mgh.) -b10- وَضَعَ He forged (a word:) he forged (poetry, على in the name of). (Mz, 8th نوع .) -b11- وَضَعَ لَفْظًا لِشَىْءٍ He applied or assigned or appropriated a word, or phrase, to denote, or signify, a thing. (Kull, 371, &c.) See also إِزَآء . -b12- وَضَعْتُ عَلَيْهِ الشَّىْءَ app. signifies I made the thing according to his, or its, measare. See قَدَرْتُ .

headwords.def: He put it, or laid it, (KL, * PS,) in, or on, a place: (PS:) he put it, or threw it, down from his hand: (TA:) contr. of رَفَعَه: (Mgh:) syn. حَطَّهُ: (K, * TA, in art. حط:) but it has a more general sense than this last. (Er-Rághib, Kull.) وَضَعَ He put down a thing: contr. of رَفَعَ. (K, voce نَصَبَ.) وَضَعَتْ She brought forth. وَضَعَ لَهُ He appointed to him, or for him, a sign, or token, &c.: see Msb in art. علم. وَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ He imposed upon him a fine, or tax, &c.
أَوْضَعَ See 1. مِنْ أَيْنَ أَوْضَعَ الرَّاكِبُ i. q. من اين أَوْضَحَ. (T, in L, art. وضح.)

He was, or became, lowly, humble, submissive, or in a state of abasement: (Msb:) or he lowered, humbled, or abased, himself. (S, K.) تَوَاضَعَا الرُّهُونَ They two laid bets, wagers, or stakes, each with the other; syn. تَرَاهَنَا. (TA, art. رهن.) تَوَاضَعَتِ الأَرْضُ (tropical:) The land was lower than that which was next to it. (TA.)
اِتَّضَعَتْ أَرْكَانُهُ : see R. Q. 2 in art. ضع.
as one of the ten predicaments, or categories, Collocation, or posture. Also The constitution of a thing; its conformation; its make. And i. q. قَنٌّ, meaning A mode, or manner, &c.
perhaps an inf. n. of وَضَعَتْ, meaning “ she brought forth: ” see 1, third sentence, in art. قرأ.
Low, ignoble, vile, or mean; of no rank, or estimation. (Msb.)

هُوَ مَوْضِعُ سِرِّى He is the depository of my secret, or secrets. مَوْضِعُهُ الرَّفْعُ Same as مَحَلُّهُ الرفع مَوْضِعٌ The proper application, or meaning, of a word. (Bd, iv. 48 and v. 45.) See 1 in art. حرف. And The case in which a word is to be used: see S, art. on the particle فَ. And The proper place of a thing. Ground; as when one says, “ a ground for, or of, belief, trust, accusation, ” &c.

A certain pace of a beast; contr. of مَرْفُوعٌ. (S in art. رفع.) مَوْضُوعٌ as an inf. n., signifying a certain manner of going of a beast: see رَفَعَ البَعِيرُ. مَوْضُوعٌ, in logic, (assumed tropical:) A subject, as opposed to a predicate: and (assumed tropical:) a substance, as opposed to an accident: in each sense, contr. of مَحْمُولٌ. (assumed tropical:) The subject of a book or the like. See مَصْنُوعٌ. أَصْوَاتٌ مَصُوغَةٌ مَوُضُوعَةٌ: see art. صوغ.
[when used as a conv. term in lexicology] i. q. إِصْطِلَاحٌ [when so used]. (Mz, 1st نوع.)
أَكَمَةٌ مُتَوَاضِعَةٌ [ (assumed tropical:) A low hill ]. (S in art. خشع.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
